contracts.purpose: Confirm a task was saved as completed without blocking the next action
contracts.trigger: Successful persisted completion, never optimistic or failedsave
contracts.provenance: Existing timing from source; mandatory crossing on every completion is latest explicit user instruction, not a platformguideline
contracts.scope: Every confirmed completion,2Dmonkey crossing from one side ofscreen to theother, Tarea completada and undo; no static substitute
contracts.focus: No focus move; success and undo remain accessible
contracts.reducedMotion: Product amendment keeps lateral crossing; remove ancillary rotations/bobbing in reduced-motion variant. Current hide-vine CSS no longer satisfies this new product requirement.
contracts.prototypeProof: Static storyboard and representative frame only; real per-completion trigger, full travel, restart on consecutive completions and undo remain required runtimechecks

contracts.purpose: Make an asynchronous load/save understandable without pretending measuredprogress
contracts.scope: Green contour, yellow filling, exactly3brownspots; label for operation
contracts.focus: No focus move; pending action disabled, submittedvalues retained
contracts.prototypeProof: Static pending state; duration and actual completion unknown until implementation

contracts.trigger: Open detail, return to list, filter and route changes
contracts.provenance: Product judgment using existing browser/dialog conventions; no external product motionprecedent
contracts.scope: No page-entrance choreography or decorative loops; retain existing navigation behavior
contracts.focus: Implementation must restore initiating control on close and expose active context
contracts.prototypeProof: Layout/navigation links only; focusmanagement and keyboard semantics require implementation validation

authority: Design proposal only. No source changes or deployment authorized.
platform: Desktop web/PWA; official W3C/WAI guidance, not a shipped-product benchmark.
